deals.date_text: 2021 (club allocation as reported in November 2021; LaLiga Impulso signed December 2021)
deals.evidence: la Real Sociedad, prevé recibir unos 107 millones
deals.headline: Real Sociedad expects about EUR 107m from LaLiga's CVC deal
deals.summary: Under LaLiga Impulso, CVC funded LaLiga's clubs in exchange for a share of the league's audiovisual revenue for 50 years through a new LaLiga company. Real Sociedad, then league leader, expected about EUR 107m, mostly for infrastructure (a 4,000-seat mini-stadium at Zubieta, a women's team building, an innovation lab). CVC holds no stake in the club itself.

deals.evidence: El coste aproximado de las obras se sitúo en 78,6 millones
deals.headline: Anoeta remodel (about EUR 78.6m), mostly club-funded, in return for a longer concession
deals.summary: Real Sociedad rebuilt the municipal Anoeta stadium between 2018 and 2020 at an approximate cost of EUR 78.6m, of which the public administrations committed only EUR 14m; in 2016, in exchange for covering the EUR 12m the city council was due to contribute, the club's concession was extended from 2033 to 2067.

deals.evidence: El club txuri-urdin ha ampliado su derecho de explotación de Anoeta hasta 2074
deals.headline: Real Sociedad's Anoeta operating rights extended to 2074
deals.summary: The board of Anoeta Kiroldegia, the public company that owns the stadium, approved an agreement extending Real Sociedad's right to use and operate Anoeta until 2074, ahead of a planned stadium expansion.

name: Real Sociedad de Fútbol, S.A.D.
notes: Revenue is net turnover ('cifra de negocios') for the year to 30 June 2025; total income including player sales was a record EUR 204.89m (EUR 63.15m of player-trading gains, e.g. Merino and Le Normand), and the net result was a profit of EUR 16.9m (EUR 16.99m), with equity of EUR 92.7m. The 2024-25 accounts PDF on the club's transparency page is a scanned image with no text layer, so the figures are cited from the club's AGM statement and Noticias de Gipuzkoa. Wages cover the first-team squad only. Pre-tax result, net debt, valuation (no Forbes/Deloitte/KPMG figure or transaction-implied value found), attendance and social-media counts were not found on a citable page. No shareholder may exceed 2% under the statutes, so there is no controlling or institutional owner; the 2025-26 accounts had not been published as of 3 October 2026. Main sponsor Baghdadi Capital (a Spanish family office) signed a three-season shirt deal in August 2025; it is a sponsor, not an investor.

owners.evidence: Ningún accionista podrá ser titular de acciones en una cantidad superior al dos por ciento (2%) del capital social.
owners.name: Dispersed shareholders (statutory cap of 2% of capital per holder)

ownership_summary: Real Sociedad de Fútbol, S.A.D. is a widely held sports company: its statutes (consolidated text approved by the shareholders on 14 December 2021) bar any shareholder from holding more than 2% of the 131,551 shares and cap any holder's votes at 5% of capital. Jokin Aperribay has chaired the board since 20 December 2008. No fund, family office or other institutional investor holds equity in the club.
